newsitem.title: USA: Ultratech cautious on near-term outlook.
newsitem.headline: Ultratech cautious on near-term outlook.

text.p: Ultratech Stepper, a maker of products used to make integrated circuits, Thursday said despite improvements in leasing and product quote activity, it remains cautious about its near-term outlook.
Earlier, the company reported a second quarter profit of $0.27 a share versus $0.44 a share one year ago.

In its earnings statement Chief Executive Officer Arthur Zafiropoulo said, "We are cautious about our near-term performance due to the typical moderation of business activity during the summer months."
Zafiropoulo said leasing arrangements experienced "significant increase" and product quotations for semiconductor makers is "improving," especially in the United States and Europe.
"We expect increased demand for our stepper products as demand for semiconductors recovers and manufacturers enter a period of capacity-driven decision-making," Zafiropoulo said.
